expected_behavior: All target models and Fusion v2 should favour the lowest drought class.
SPI3 should show the strongest drought response; SPI6/SPI12 may remain lower if the signal is recent.
SPI6 should show a strong seasonal drought response; SPI12 may remain lower if drought is not persistent.
SPI12 should show the strongest persistent drought response and Fusion v2 should reflect persistence.
SPI3, SPI6, SPI12, and Fusion v2 should all show a strong drought response.
